settings.name: PAC_ORG_LIVE_TEST
settings.required_when: explicitly running the optional real-provider organizational check; ordinary isolated test runs remove it

settings.name: PAC_OWNER_KEY
settings.required_when: owner workspace is enabled outside local development

settings.name: PAC_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET
settings.required_when: every preview and production deployment

settings.name: PAC_STORE
settings.required_when: always; defaults are environment-specific

settings.name: PAC_ASK_RECORD_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.required_when: optional; blank keeps owner-deletable ASK records without automatic expiry; positive days apply to new records

settings.name: PAC_DATA_ENV
settings.required_when: every Vercel preview and production deployment

settings.name: PAC_DATABASE_URL
settings.required_when: migrations, imports, or runtime-role provisioning run

settings.name: PAC_DATABASE_SSL
settings.required_when: database transport requires an explicit SSL mode

settings.name: PAC_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL
settings.required_when: PAC_STORE=postgres or PAC_CONTENT_SOURCE=postgres

settings.name: PAC_RUNTIME_DATABASE_SSL
settings.required_when: runtime database transport requires an explicit SSL mode

settings.name: PAC_IMPORT_ACTOR
settings.required_when: an import actor must be attributed explicitly

settings.name: PAC_DATABASE_EDITABLE_SURFACES
settings.required_when: selected editable surfaces use PostgreSQL during local staged rollout; production uses PAC_CONTENT_SOURCE=postgres for all surfaces

settings.name: PAC_SUPABASE_URL
settings.required_when: private source-object loading is explicitly run

settings.name: PAC_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
settings.required_when: private source-object loading is explicitly run

settings.name: PAC_CONSULTATION_TRACKING_SECRET
settings.required_when: consultation intake is activated, PAC_CONSULTATION_ACTIVATION_EVIDENCE_ID is selected for existing-request tracking, or this secret is configured in production; must pass the production non-placeholder and variation checks even when new intake is off

settings.name: PAC_CONSULTATION_POLICY_VERSION
settings.required_when: consultation intake is activated

settings.name: PAC_CONSULTATION_ACTIVATION_EVIDENCE_ID
settings.required_when: consultation intake or tracking is activated; must match an approved committed evidence bundle

settings.name: PAC_CONSULTATION_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.required_when: consultation intake is activated

settings.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
settings.required_when: the approved Anthropic adapter is activated

settings.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
settings.required_when: the approved OpenAI adapter is activated

settings.name: CRON_SECRET
settings.required_when: a Vercel cron schedule is activated

settings.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
settings.required_when: approved live Perplexity research is activated

settings.name: PAC_CATALOG_PATH
settings.required_when: the ignored resolver does not provide the 578-record catalog

settings.name: PAC_IMPORT_BENCHMARK_DATABASE_URL
settings.required_when: the optional local import benchmark is run

settings.name: PAC_TEST_POSTGRES_BIN
settings.required_when: the optional local PostgreSQL integration suites cannot discover the server binaries

settings.name: NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID
settings.required_when: Optional framework-provided deployment identifier used by Next.js for asset versioning; never a credential or an application activation setting.

settings.required_when: optional legacy team-key sign-in only; direct owner access does not require it

settings.name: SP_CLONE_RESEND_API_KEY
settings.required_when: only when the standalone SharePoint-style clone's request-support workflow should email a notification through the owner's own Resend account; the /api/sp-clone-request route degrades to save-only, no email, when unset

settings.name: SP_CLONE_NOTIFY_EMAIL
settings.required_when: paired with SP_CLONE_RESEND_API_KEY; the owner's own recipient address for sp-clone request notifications

settings.name: SHARE_CHECK_SOURCE_DIR
settings.required_when: only for scripts/share-link-test.mjs when the share rule should be read from a different checkout, as the runner workflow does with the deployed branch; defaults to the current checkout

settings.name: SHARE_CHECK_BASE_URL
settings.required_when: only for scripts/share-link-test.mjs to check a site other than the production address

settings.name: SHARE_CHECK_SEND
settings.required_when: only for scripts/share-link-test.mjs; set to true to post the report to /api/sp-clone-request so the owner receives it by email
